when.description: Match conditions. Keys must come from the closed vocabulary in policy-compiler/conditions.json (compliance_hold, service_tier, log_severity, span_status, http_status_gte, metric_is_slo_relevant, over_budget, log_severity_not_in, span_status_not) plus any_of/all_of groups whose items are condition objects or the literal true (always-match). The vocabulary and value types are enforced at compile time by a schema generated from conditions.json (see compile.build_when_schema).
